text:
name: rag_knowledge_base_wire
question: >-
  Close the three functional gaps found in the rag_knowledge_base_build review
  (code_reviews/2026-08-15_rag-knowledge-base-proposal-review.md + follow-up code review):
  (1) the workflow hook is not wired to the stores, so rag_augment retrieves nothing;
  (2) commit_sha is a soft freshness boost instead of the hard scope filter the design
  requires; (3) the graph-expansion leg is a stub (hardcoded seed score, missing
  relationship/depth, and a canonical-id vs elementId mismatch). Build order follows the
  seam outward: wire stores first, then harden the commit filter, then repair graph
  expansion, then wire the remaining pure functions, then independent verification.
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true   # requested: chain the agent phases' sessions so shared repo context is cache-reads
    context:
      brief: >-
        This is a repair pass on branch feature/rag-kb-build (not main)…
